The National Account Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and growing strategic national account opportunities across the Foodservice trade channel.

This role requires an experienced national accounts hunter with a proven track record of building, expanding, and maintaining customer relationships across a variety of foodservice segments, including QSR, fast casual, casual dining, family dining, hospitality, and emerging growth channels.

The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial discipline, customer insight, and cross-functional leadership to advance branded, custom, and exclusive fully cooked protein solutions from concept through commercialization, while delivering profitable growth, distribution expansion, and long-term customer value.

· Own and grow a portfolio of national foodservice accounts, with emphasis on strategic chains, emerging growth customers, and new business opportunities across the foodservice trade channel.
· Develop and execute customer-specific annual and multi-year business plans that deliver revenue, volume, margin, distribution, innovation, and profitability objectives.
· Identify, qualify, and advance new account opportunities by building a strong sales pipeline, leveraging customer insights, market trends, menu needs, and the company’s fully cooked protein cap

🚀 Key Account Executive (Outbound) (m/w/d) – Berlin (Vor Ort)
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt im Vertrieb bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs weltweit?
Werde Teil unseres ambitionierten Teams in Berlin und unterstütze kleine Unternehmen im gesamten DACH-Markt mit modernen Payment- und POS-Lösungen.
Bei SumUp verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir helfen kleinen Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu sein, indem wir Zahlungen einfach, zugänglich und unkompliziert machen.
Heute unterstützen wir bereits über 4 Millionen Händler in mehr als 30 Ländern – und wir wachsen weiter.
Als Account Executive (Outbound) übernimmst du den gesamten Sales Cycle und baust aktiv unseren Outbound-Vertrieb in Deutschland mit auf.
Du konzentrierst dich auf etablierte kleine Unternehmen (Upmarket SMBs) mit einem monatlichen Zahlungsvolumen von über 15.000 € und arbeitest als vertrauenswürdiger Berater, nicht als klassischer Produktverkäufer.
Diese neu geschaffene Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Prozesse mitzugestalten und den deutschen Markt aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
🎯 Deine Aufgaben
Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Proaktive Neukundengewinnung über Cold Calls, E-Mails und soziale Netzwerke.
Eigenständige Betreuung deines Vertriebsgebiets inklusive Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse.
Aufbau und Pflege einer hochwertigen Sales Pipeline.
Durchführung strukturierter Discovery- und Beratungsgespräche, um die Anforderungen der Kunden zu verstehen und passende Payment-, POS- und Kiosklösungen zu empfehlen.
Durchführung überzeugender Produktpräsentationen und Demos.
Souveräner Umgang mit Einwänden sowie Gespräche auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführerebene.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie Sales Enablement und Product.
Analyse deiner Performance, Erreichen deiner Ziele und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung anhand von Daten und Feedback.
Aktive Mitgestaltung einer leistungsorientierten Outbound-Vertriebskultur in unserem Berliner Büro.
👀 Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Outbound-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SMB- oder Upmarket-SMB-Umfeld.
Nachweisbare Erfolge im Full-Cycle Sales mit eigener Umsatzverantwortung.
Erfahrung in der Kaltakquise, Leadgenerierung und dem Aufbau einer Sales Pipeline.
Beratungsorientierter Vertriebsansatz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexere Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Deutsch auf C2- oder muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation, Hunter-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung.
Begeisterung für Technologie, Payment-Lösungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern.
💥 Das bieten wir dir
Attraktives Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision – dein Erfolg bestimmt dein Einkommen.
Die Möglichkeit, bei einem schnell wachsenden globalen FinTech echten Einfluss zu nehmen.
Eine Office-First-Kultur in unserem Berliner Büro mit einem motivierten und internationalen Team.
2.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Zertifizierungen und Workshops.
30 Tage Sabbatical nach drei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit.
Ein diverses und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden.
Ein attraktives Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Wenn du im Outbound-Vertrieb erfolgreich sein möchtest, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Teil eines schnell wachsenden FinTechs werden willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
Bewirb dich jetzt und wachse gemeinsam mit SumUp in Berlin.

Hello. We’re Teya . Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving.

Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support.

Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you What will you be doing? As we continue to expand our operations in the UK, we’re looking for our third Sales Manager to join our expanding Independent Sales Agent channel.

This is a fast paced, high velocity, transactional field team made up of freelance sellers. With the support of our dedicated recruitment team, you will be responsible for growing the team from 0 to ~60 people over the coming months and delivering our revenue goals.

Ultimately you will also be responsible for: Leading, managing and developing a dynamic team of commission-only sales representatives of varying levels of experience, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives Working hands-on with the team, designing and implementing effective sales processes to drive revenue growth Providing initial training for new sellers and then ongoing mentorship to develop individuals and increase their volume of monthly sales Conduct regular reviews with individuals to ensure their continuous engagement with Teya and create a long-term partnership Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing and product development to act as a voice of the seller and ensure we have the best tools available to our team Analyse sales data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement to increase channel growth What are we looking for?

Proven track record of successful field sales management experience, preferably in the payments industry or a related field Demonstratable experience of designing and implementing sales training for a variety of experience levels Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a commission-only sales team to achieve and exceed targets Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic sales plans that align with overall business objectives.

Proactive and results-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement and a willingness to take initiative in a dynamic and competitive market. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Knowledge of relevant industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics is preferable Ability to travel as needed to meet with sellers, attend industry events and support the sales team in various locations. What can we offer you?

On top of your basic salary you will be able to earn uncapped commissions 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, 1-1 therapy sessions, meditation sessions and access to digital fitness and nutrition apps Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices Private Medical and Life Insurance Improved pension Scheme Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us. Originally posted on Himalayas

Works with sales support staff, pre and post sales staff to further customer relationships forecast, track territory opportunities, and close the deal Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or Engineering or another related field of study or equivalent work experience 3+ years of experience in Sales within IT industry including, but not limited to inside sales Prior experience selling software products and/or subscription selling working directly with F2000 accounts Experience in managing all aspects of the sales cycle, including prospecting, developing the customer relationship at all levels and the implementation of the account plans Experience working with multi-element revenue models, which include both one time and recurring revenue streams, which may include multiple products Capable of closing complicated deals from discovering sales opportunities to contract completion Able to up-sell existing accounts as well as proactively identify and acquire new customers Comfortable being an active participant (not necessarily leader) in highly technical discussions Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire.

Senior Sales Director, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA

The Senior Sales Manager, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, channel management, and business growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection portfolio, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, customer satisfaction, and profitability throughout the region.
The position has full responsibility for regional sales performance, distributor network optimization, key account management, forecasting accuracy, business planning, and the development of high-performing sales teams.

The incumbent will collaborate closely with global commercial leadership, product management, marketing, service, operations, and channel partners to drive business success and support Thermo Fisher Scientific's mission of making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer and will report to the Director MCS EMEA

Commercial Leadership
Develop and execute the regional commercial strategy for Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection across EMEA.
Deliver or exceed annual revenue, order booking, profitability, and market share objectives.
Establish regional growth initiatives aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business plans.
Identify emerging market opportunities and develop expansion strategies across government, defense, homeland security, customs, critical infrastructure, transportation, nuclear, and industrial sectors.
Lead regional pricing strategies and commercial negotiations to maximize profitability and competitive positioning.
Sales Management
Lead, coach, and develop Regional Sales Managers and commercial team members across EMEA.
Establish clear performance objectives and accountability measures for direct and indirect reports.
Drive a high-performance sales culture focused on customer engagement, operational excellence, and growth.
Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and execution against strategic objectives.
Ensure effective territory management and resource allocation across the region.
Channel & Distributor Management
Manage and optimize the regional distributor network.
Evaluate distributor performance and implement improvement plans where required.
Recruit, develop, and train new distributors to support strategic growth objectives.
Identify opportunities to streamline channel structures and improve market coverage.
Ensure distributors maintain appropriate product knowledge, compliance standards, and customer support capabilities.
Strategic Account Management
Develop executive-level relationships with key customers, government agencies, strategic accounts, and channel partners.
Lead commercial negotiations for complex and high-value opportunities.
Support global account initiatives and coordinate multi-country opportunities.
Manage critical customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of business issues.
Drive customer retention and long-term partnership development.
Business Planning & Forecasting
Develop and execute annual regional business plans.
Own forecast accuracy, pipeline management, and sales reporting.
Utilize CRM tools to manage opportunities, customer segmentation, and business intelligence.
Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer requirements to support decision-making.
Present business reviews and growth plans to executive leadership.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with Product Management, Marketing, Service, Operations, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering teams.
Lead regional implementation of new product launches and commercial initiatives.
Participate in global strategic projects and business transformation initiatives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, integrations, and organizational change activities where applicable.
Customer Experience & Operational Excellence
Ensure customer satisfaction objectives are consistently achieved or exceeded.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across commercial processes.
Promote a customer-centric culture throughout the organization.
Support resolution of complex service, technical, and commercial issues.
Ensure compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and ethical business practices.
Industry Representation
Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, trade shows, workshops, and government forums.
Build strategic relationships with industry leaders, regulatory authorities, and key stakeholders.
Act as a recognized commercial leader within the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection markets.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Science, Technology, or related discipline.

The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide.

Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.

Fresha ’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha 's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha 's expansion.

You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate) Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop Added bonus Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry At Fresha , we value passion and potential as much as specific skills.

If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process Screening Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins) 1st Stage - Video interview with Team Lead (45 mins) Final Stage + Presentation - Video interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins) We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.

Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe. Inclusive workforce At Fresha , we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.

We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our clients brand, brings 187 years of heritage in engineered storage solutions. We manufacture Glass-Fused-to-Steel (GFS) tanks, offering a durable, modular, and sustainable alternative to concrete. Our applications span biogas, wastewater, portable and process water storage, aquaculture, agriculture, and dry storage.
They are seeking a dynamic International Sales & Business Development Manager to drive adoption of GFS tanks across Europe. The role is not only about selling, but about shifting market perception away from concrete toward advanced GFS solutions. This requires a professional who can blend strategic marketing, consultative sales, and long-term relationship building.

Build and execute a market penetration strategy to replace concrete tanks with our clients GFS tanks.
Lead business development efforts with EPCs, project developers, and end-users across Europe.
Drive marketing initiatives – positioning our client as the superior alternative in durability, sustainability, and lifecycle cost.
Manage the end-to-end sales cycle – from lead generation and solution positioning to deal closure.
Provide market intelligence on competitors, pricing, and customer behavior.
Represent the company at industry exhibitions, conferences, and trade associations.
Collaborate with technical teams to deliver solutions aligned with customer needs.

10-15 years of international sales/business development experience in capital equipment, water, or biogas sectors.
Proven success in shifting customer mindset and replacing entrenched solutions (e.g., concrete, steel) with advanced technologies.
Strong marketing orientation – able to craft value propositions, storytelling, and campaigns, not just transactional sales.
Resilient and entrepreneurial mindset – thrives in opening new markets and building something from the ground up.
Skilled at navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.
Engineering or business degree; MBA a plus.

Be part of a company with 187 years of legacy and global credibility.
Lead the growth of GFS tanks in Europe under our clients brand.
Entrepreneurial role with high visibility and direct impact on market transformation.
Competitive package with performance-driven incentives.

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.

By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

The ideal Territory Account Executive will pro-actively network, cold call, and sell to multiple contacts within an organization, including "C" levels. This person will manage and develop relationships with customers and provide a consultative sales approach that delivers the highest level of account management services.

The Territory Account Executive should share the goals and concerns of the client and understand the technology partner and products available to meet their goals and solve their challenges. This is a territory based role focusing on growing existing accounts and adding new mid-market accounts in Maryland/DMV.

· Position, configure and quote product and service solutions to clients.
· Participate in industry organizations such as ISSA, ISACA, OWASP etc.
· Manage leads and opportunities through the companies Salesforce and other CRM tools.
· Accurately and consistently report sales forecasts and opportunity funnels

· Set proper expectations and maintain open communication with clients and vendors through the lifecycle of the sales process.
· Effectively leverage supporting resources in the sales process with the spirit of teamwork and cooperation.
· Professionally develop and present sales presentations to large groups and executive level clients. Position Requirements:
· Minimum 5 years outside sales experience, preferably in cybersecurity or infrastructure and services.
· Current enterprise security space experience preferred
· Strong, established relationships with key accounts in the territory required
· Requires experience with Salesforce.com
· Strong group presentation skills a must
· Verifiable history of exceeding sales goals and generating leads
· Demonstrated ability of lead generation and opening new accounts
· Experience selling professional services, security audits and assessments a plus
· Bachelors degree preferred
· Network security vendor related certifications strongly preferred
· Demonstrates a willingness to learn and use AI-enabled tools We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application. Why GuidePoint? GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,200 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation. Some added perks…. Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions) Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options) Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment Pet Benefit Option Originally posted on Himalayas

Who is Eleos Health ?
Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human. Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do .
What is the opportunity: We’re hiring an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with our existing customers as we scale our digital health SaaS platform.

This role blends account management and consultative sales, giving you the opportunity to deepen customer partnerships while driving revenue growth by selling new products, features, and expansions.

You’ll work closely with healthcare stakeholders and internal teams to help customers achieve meaningful outcomes while expanding their use of our platform. Who you are: You are a relationship-first, growth-minded professional who enjoys working with existing customers and identifying ways to deliver more value.

You’re comfortable having strategic conversations with clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders and know how to balance trust-building with revenue responsibility. You thrive in fast-paced startup environments, take ownership of your work, and are motivated by both customer success and business impact. How will you contribute:
Manage and grow a book with significant ARR expansion responsibility
Collaborate with internal teams including Product, CS Ops, Support, and Implementation to resolve issues and deliver improvements
Drive customer retention, adoption, and long-term account health
Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning clinical, operational, and RCM/billing audiences.
Sell new products, modules, and features aligned to customer needs and outcomes
Manage expansion opportunities through the full sales cycle and meet or exceed growth targets
Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and expansion quota ownership
Own renewals end-to-end, including contract discussions and pricing conversations
Develop account plans aligned to customer goals and Eleos growth objectives

Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve premium growth and profitability objectives for the Retail Excess Casualty portfolio.

Expand market penetration within targeted industries, territories, and distribution channels.

Support long-term business growth through strategic relationship development and market engagement.
Broker & Client Relationship Management
Participate in industry events, conferences, and networking activities to strengthen market visibility.
Build and maintain strong relationships with brokerage leadership, producers, and key agency stakeholders.
Serve as a primary market-facing representative for the Retail Excess Casualty business unit.
Conduct regular agency visits, broker meetings, and market outreach activities to strengthen partnerships.
Facilitate communication between underwriting teams and distribution partners to support business objectives.
Deliver presentations, product updates, and training sessions to brokers and agencies.
Collaboration & Market Strategy
Partner with underwriting teams to align business development efforts with risk appetite and profitability objectives.
Provide market intelligence regarding competitor activity, pricing trends, coverage developments, and emerging risks.
Assist in developing product enhancements and strategies to address evolving customer needs.
Sales Planning & Performance Management
Develop and manage business development pipelines and prospecting activities.
Track and analyze production trends, broker engagement metrics, and growth initiatives.
Support territory planning and execution to maximize market opportunities.
Contribute to annual business planning, forecasting, and strategic growth initiatives

Strength in Trust
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016.

Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like.

OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale.

Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
The Challenge
We are looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise. Account Executives have a critical role and responsibility to deliver new client acquisition in zero-base accounts, while also ensuring successful relationships and revenue growth with existing customers.
OneTrust is a fast-growing SaaS enterprise platform with a strong growth trajectory. We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals.

The Account Executive (AE) is responsible for consistently generating, qualifying, and executing opportunities that support our customers in the pursuit of becoming more trusted organizations and drive revenue for OneTrust. AEs are expected to use their thorough knowledge of the industry and excellent value-based sales skills to create the best solutions and solve complex customer problems. AEs must bring useful insights and best practices to customers and prospects.

About Qorelo
Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz, and we sell to enterprise customers across DACH as well as to selected SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

Negotiating and closing. Multi-year agreements, framework contracts, ramp deals, procurement rounds — you hold the line on value instead of discounting your way to a signature.
A forecast we can plan on. You keep Attio, our CRM, clean and current, and your forecast holds up.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

You are a German speaking Account Manager, excited to join a growing team focused on demonstrating ownership of our clients’ experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You will work closely with members of the Customer Success team, Sales team, and other internal Constructor teams to support and grow your book of business.

You are an advocate for your customer and work with internal teams to provide feedback to Product, create advocacy opportunities for Marketing, and visibility into use cases and customer health for the organization. You demonstrate a high degree of accountability and ownership.

You are the strategic lead for the clients in your book of business.
You will build strong relationships with your clients in order to understand their business goals, business needs, the priorities of these goals and needs, and how Constructor maps to these goals and needs.
You will manage complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level).
You will uncover and manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner.
You will grow to be well versed on your clients’ business needs and the Constructor product in order to educate clients on potential new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities.
You will regularly update internal systems and attend internal meetings in order to document and communicate customer status, needs, risk, renewal next steps, and upsell next steps.

Minimum of 3+ Years of proven experience working directly with large enterprise clients a role within Account Management, Customer Success, and/or Sales within a SaaS company, preferably one that works directly with ecommerce clients.
German Language skills are a MUST!
Proven ability to influence, present to, and build deep relationships with our customers, especially at the VP+ level.
Proven ability to uncover and properly manage risk within your book of business in a timely and effective manner.
Proven ability to educate clients on new use cases, features and integrations that create added value and uncover potential upsell opportunities.
Proven ability in managing complex, enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from start to finish – effectively demonstrating the product and the business and economic benefits to each stakeholder (from business champion to the C-Suite level).
Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual retention and expansion goals.
Attend and ensure the success of Quarterly Business Reviews with Customers to ensure understanding of client goals and how Constructor maps to those goals.
Proven ability to juggle multiple Account Management projects and recurring responsibilities at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Proven ability to work cross functionally with various teams to meet the aforementioned needs and goals of your clients - this includes, but is not limited to, working with Sales, CSMs, SEs, SAs, Data Science teams, Product+Eng teams. This includes the ability to tailor language and asks for these teams while maintaining an eye on timeline, SLAs, and the overall client goals and needs.
Solid knowledge and understanding of ecommerce business needs - typical goals, KPIs, terminology, and trends.
Solid understanding of analytics and statistics, with an ideal focus on being able to analyze and present data sets pertaining to ecommerce, ab testing, and conversion.
Proven ability to acquire and maintain a working knowledge of the complete capabilities of Constructor’s ever-evolving products and capabilities.

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe. Following our €14M Series A , backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.

With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane , leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time. The market is growing by 20% every year , fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act .

We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.
Your purpose at Kertos
Als Channel Sales Manager übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für den Partnerkanal von Kertos – von der Pipeline bis zum Umsatz. Du baust das Ökosystem von Grund auf auf: du entscheidest, welche Partner wir angehen, gewinnst sie und machst aus diesen Beziehungen eine verlässliche, messbare Wachstumsquelle. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, damit Partnerschaften kein Silo bilden, sondern echten Impact im gesamten Unternehmen erzeugen.
Auf- und Ausbau des Partnerkanals mit belastbaren, vertrauensbasierten Beziehungen zu Key-Partnern – mit dem Ziel, Umsatzwachstum zu treiben und Partner- und Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
Rekrutierung und Onboarding kommerzieller Partner, darunter Reseller und MSSPs, sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Partner-Go-to-Market-Strategie.
Entwicklung skalierbarer Prozesse zur Gewinnung, Aktivierung und langfristigen Betreuung strategischer Partner – damit das Programm strukturiert und nachhaltig wächst.
Konzeption und Durchführung von Partner-Enablement-Programmen, Webinaren und Trainings, die Partner in die Lage versetzen, Kertos selbstständig und überzeugend bei ihren Kunden zu positionieren.
Aufbau eines nachhaltigen Partner-Ökosystems, das qualifizierte Leads bei Endkunden generiert und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erschließt.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Product und Sales, um Partnerinitiativen mit den Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und den Partnerkanal konsequent weiterzuentwickeln.
The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring
Du hast nachweislich Partnerprogramme im B2B SaaS-Umfeld aufgebaut oder wesentlich mitgestaltet – idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up.
Du hast einen Hintergrund im Channel Sales mit einer quota-carrying Rolle und hast langjährige Erfahrung darin, wie Pipeline über Partner generiert und Deals gewonnen werden.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und lieferst Ergebnisse, auch wenn kein Playbook existiert – das ist dein bevorzugtes Umfeld, nicht dein Problem.
Deine Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten auf Entscheiderebene sind auf Deutsch und Englisch gleichermaßen stark.
Erfahrung in der Compliance-, Cybersecurity- oder Legal-Tech-Branche ist ein echtes Plus – du weißt, wer unsere Kunden sind und welche Partner für sie relevant sind.
Du misst deinen Erfolg an Partnership-sourced Pipeline und ARR.
Why Kertos
Dein Erfolg ist unser Erfolg : Du partizipierst am Unternehmenserfolg durch unseren Virtual Share Incentive Plan (VSIP)
Cutting Edge AI Technologie : Führende VCs haben in unsere Vision und nachhaltiges Wachstum investiert, damit wir nachhaltig verändern, wie Compliance-Maßnahmen gehandhabt werden
Großer Impact : Bei uns bekommst du Verantwortung ab Tag 1, arbeitest selbstständig an Themen und bringst so Kertos richtig voran
Starkes Onboarding : Keine Ahnung von Compliance? Kein Problem, wir schlauen dich auf und stellen dir einen Onboarding-Buddy an die Seite
Regelmäßiges Feedback : Wir leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und unterstützen dich bei deinem Wachstum mit regelmäßigen 1-1s, 360 Grad Feedback, Schulungen und einem Top Netzwerk von Expert*innen
Mental Health : In Zusammenarbeit mit nilo legen wir Wert auf dein Wohlbefinden und bieten allen Mitarbeitenden individuelle Unterstützung für ihre mentale Gesundheit
Keep growing : Um deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung zu unterstützen, stellen wir dir ein jährliches Budget von 1.500€ zur Verfügung
Volle Flexibilität : Ob im Münchner Hauptquartier, Berliner Büro oder aus dem Homeoffice – wir sind flexibel und du happy
F ür Sportsfreund*innen : Wir bezuschussen deine Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für den sportlichen Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag
Fahrrad Leasing : Neues Fahrrad gefällig? Easy, nutze unser unsere Partnerschaft mit JobRad und lease dir ein Fahrrad
Gemeinsam stark : Wir arbeiten über unsere Standorte hinweg eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und schaffen durch echtes Miteinander eine starke, einzigartige Kultur, die uns erfolgreich macht.

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
For almost 50 years, ImmunoDiagnostics, previously known as Phadia, has maintained global leadership in allergy testing and become one of the world’s leading autoimmune disease test providers. About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.
As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You’ll join our Enterprise Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne or Frankfurt.
What you’ll be doing
In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners’ businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
Our humble expectations
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You’re comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You’re highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You’re comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in English and German.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.
You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.
You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.
Next steps
If this sounds like an opportunity you’d be excited about, we’d love to hear from you.
After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.
Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We’ll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. s.h: 1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral

· Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature.

Counterpart is an Insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what's ahead.

That's why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system — where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence.

Join us in shaping a smarter future, helping businesses Do More With Less Risk®.
As a member of the risk engineering team, you will be responsible for the production of premium through proper risk analysis and effective distribution through our digital distribution partners. In collaboration with the Territory Managers, engineering, and operations team, you will leverage your industry knowledge and broker relationships to develop management liability and professional liability insurance products that brokers are eager to promote to their clients.

s.h: AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE YOU WILL
s.t:
Process and quote submissions accurately and on time: Work through a high volume of incoming management and professional liability submissions using Counterpart's digital platform, following established underwriting guidelines and procedures to generate timely, accurate quotes.
Learn and apply ML/PL underwriting fundamentals: Build working knowledge of policy forms, coverage terms, rating procedures, and authority parameters under the guidance of senior Risk Engineers and your team lead.
Follow up on open quotes: Actively work your quote queue. Reaching out to brokers on pending submissions, answering straightforward inquiries, and escalating non-routine or over-authority situations to the appropriate team member.
Support broker relationships: Engage with brokers in your assigned territory with responsiveness and professionalism, providing reliable service on routine submissions and helping reinforce Counterpart's reputation at every touchpoint.
Capture and relay broker feedback: Surface broker reactions, questions, and market observations to your team, contributing to the information loop that helps the team improve guidelines and the quoting experience.
Represent Counterpart in your territory: Participate in broker meetings and local industry events to build familiarity with the market and support Counterpart's visibility.
Work toward production targets: Contribute to team premium and submission goals, tracking your individual progress and flagging obstacles to your manager.
Leverage AI: Use Counterpart’s Agentic AI tools to help in your daily workflows

s.h: WE LOOK FOR TEAMMATES WHO HAVE
s.t:
1–2 years of underwriting, insurance, or related experience, with exposure to management liability, professional liability, or specialty lines preferred but not required.
Eagerness to learn ML/PL products: Curiosity about policy forms, coverage terms, and risk assessment, with a willingness to build technical knowledge quickly on the job.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through: Comfortable working through high-volume, process-driven workflows accurately and consistently.
Clear, professional communication: Able to engage brokers and internal teammates with responsiveness and care, even on routine matters.
Adaptability and coachability: Thrives in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment and responds well to feedback and direction.
College degree or equivalent experience.

Tanner Hackett, CEO : Having founded two other major startups, including Button and Lazada, Tanner now spends his time focused on mental health through his philanthropy,, in addition to reading, surfing, yoga, and enjoying the outdoors.
Kelly North , Vice President of Revenue : Kelly leads revenue strategy at Counterpart, with a strong focus on accelerating growth through distribution, sales operations, marketing, and digital transformation. She brings deep experience driving results by building high-performing teams and executing collaborative, cross-functional strategies. Outside of work, Kelly enjoys spending time with her family, is an avid reader, and has a passion for all things outdoors.
Brad Bahler , Director Field Underwriting : Brad has over a decade of experience in management liability underwriting. He managed one of the largest books of small business management liability risks at Travelers, where he was known for his deep understanding of coverage, outstanding submission response times, and boundless enthusiasm for the space.
Jade Rabacal, National Distribution Lead : Jade brings an end-to-end insurance background spanning retail, wholesale, MGUs, and a legacy carrier. She is the National Distribution Lead at Counterpart, driving growth across all product lines and verticals.

Prior to Counterpart, she served as Vice President of Business Development within the Cyber and Professional Lines Group at Tokio Marine HCC. Jade is known for her broker-centric approach and ability to build scalable partnerships in complex risk markets.
Marc Everds: Technical Product Manager at Counterpart. Marc bridges the gap between product strategy and engineering execution, helping build the technology infrastructure that powers Counterpart's underwriting and distribution capabilities.

We are seeking an ambitious, self-directed Sales Manager with a winning and growth mindset, a relentless hunter, ready to go out and build the business — to own revenue growth for Spire 's aviation portfolio and bundles across the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.
The role carries two tightly linked motions. The first is the partner ecosystem: owning and selling to the commercial defense contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, and data integrators that deliver national aviation, airspace, and security programs in these markets, the most frequent route to revenue. The second is direct sales to the civil aviation and defense agencies behind those programs.
Your customer landscape extends beyond civil aviation: maritime security, airspace security, and multi-domain awareness users are key potential customers for Spire's data across the region.

This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a seller who understands how governments and their delivery ecosystems buy through long procurement cycles, tenders, offsets, and partner-delivered programs.

Operating with the autonomy of a regional owner, you will establish Spire as the trusted aviation data partner across two of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world, selling a product that is, quite literally, powered by space.
As Spire's portfolio expands, this role is also expected to grow into selling integrated products: Aviation + Weather and Aviation + RF geolocation (RFGL) signal-interference products — giving you more ways into every account.

Own the territory: Build and execute a territory plan spanning the Middle East and Asia-Pacific — mapping the contractor and integrator ecosystem, agencies, budgets, procurement vehicles, and prime relationships country by country, and prioritizing the opportunities with the highest revenue potential.
Hunt relentlessly and exceed targets: Meet and surpass assigned quota through proactive outbound prospecting, disciplined qualification, and full-cycle execution. This is a hunting role: you create demand rather than wait for it.
Sell to and through the partner ecosystem (B2B2G): Own relationships with commercial defense contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, and data integrators across the region — identifying, qualifying, and winning positions that embed Spire’s aviation data inside their programs, platforms, applications, and bids. Get onto bid teams before the tender publishes, secure teaming agreements, and make Spire the default data layer on recurring recompetes.
Build the reseller channel: Structure and negotiate reselling and distribution agreements with data integrators and software companies, creating a scalable indirect revenue engine alongside your direct business.
Sell direct to government (B2G): Uncover the operational needs of civil aviation authorities, ANSPs, defense and security agencies, maritime security and multi-domain awareness organizations, search and rescue organizations, transport ministries, and research institutions, and propose tailored solutions built on Spire’s global flight tracking, historical data, and analytics.
Navigate government procurement: Lead responses to tenders, RFPs, and RFIs; structure deals through direct contracts, teaming agreements, and reseller or integration partnerships; and manage long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with rigor and patience.
Master the product: Develop deep expertise across Spire’s aviation APIs and ADS-B coverage, historical flight datasets, and their applications in airspace monitoring and security, maritime and multi-domain awareness, airport and airline operations, SAR, safety oversight, and AI model development — to communicate compelling value to technical and executive audiences alike.
Grow into the integrated portfolio: As Spire’s offerings expand, position Aviation + Weather and Aviation + RFGL signal-interference integrated products in your accounts — capturing and qualifying customer demand signals today and feeding them to product and leadership to inform the roadmap and the timing of expansion.
Build lasting relationships: Develop trusted, long-term relationships with contractor, integrator, and software company executives and senior government stakeholders, understanding their missions, constraints, and objectives to position Spire for multi-year engagements.
Negotiate and close: Lead commercial negotiations on terms and pricing across government contracting frameworks, reseller and distribution agreements, and partner margins, reaching mutually beneficial deals and closing reliably.
Manage your pipeline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, forecasting rigorously and following up on every lead, tender, and opportunity.
Know the market: Track government aviation programs, defense, airspace, and maritime security modernization initiatives, multi-domain awareness programs, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and shape demand early — before tenders are published.
Represent Spire: Raise Spire’s profile at airshows, defense and security exhibitions, and ATM and ANSP forums across the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, generating qualified opportunities and strengthening the partner ecosystem.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with product, engineering, legal, and customer success teams to align solutions with customer requirements — including data sovereignty, security, and compliance considerations for government buyers — and feed market insight back into the product roadmap.

A winning and growth mindset: a relentless hunter who goes out and creates opportunities, thrives on outbound pursuit, and treats every account as expandable.
8+ years of experience in sales or business development selling data products, SaaS, or technology solutions in the Middle East and/or Asia-Pacific.
A proven track record selling through or alongside prime contractors, systems integrators, application service providers, resellers or data integrators (B2B2G) and to governments (B2G) — including positioning your solution as a subcontracted or embedded component of a partner-delivered program.
Experience structuring and negotiating reselling or distribution agreements with data integrators and software companies.
A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas.
Domain fluency in aviation, aerospace, defense, maritime data, or geospatial data, or deep experience selling digital transformation and analytics into government, security, or research organizations.
The range to grow with the role: comfort expanding into commercial deal cycles and a broader, integrated product portfolio as territory scope evolves.
A consultative, value-based selling style with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, effective from working level to minister level.
Proven ability to build and maintain trusted relationships across cultures, time zones, and seniority levels.
Proficiency with sales tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
